entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I don't know how to put this, but it's[n]rather...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Mundane.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Speaking frankly, I was expecting more[n]in the way of glitz and debauchery.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Was this not described as a den of[n]pleasure and madness? Almost akin[n]to a Palace itself?
I wouldn't go that far.
It's only afternoon.[clr 27]
Don't relax yet.[clr 27]

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Yeah, that's kinda much.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: But don't get too comfortable. Trust me,[n]this place is full of surprises...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Yeah, that's it. It seemed way more[n]crazy when we came here at night.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Ah... That explains it. So I have yet[n]to see the true face of this town.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I know it sounds cool, but don't get the[n]wrong idea. You never know what's[n]gonna pop up here...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Yeah. By the time you realize somethin's[n]off, they've already swept you up...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Really?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: *giggle* Well, I confess I've always[n]wondered what it'd be like to be[n]swept off my feet!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Yeah, that's not exactly how it goes...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Gah! Duck and cover!

entries.speaker: Lala Escargot
entries.en: Don't you "duck and cover" me, kid.[n]Hm...?

entries.speaker: Lala Escargot
entries.en: Oh, you're Ichiko-chan's... What are[n]you doing here?
I wanted to see you.
Just hanging out.

entries.speaker: Lala Escargot
entries.en: Oh, you can't just say things like that.

entries.speaker: Lala Escargot
entries.en: Are these your friends? There's gotta[n]be other places you could go...

entries.speaker: Lala Escargot
entries.en: Then these must be your friends. But[n]there's gotta be other places you could[n]go...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Do you... know her, [fName]?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Um... We've been trying to investigate[n]this area...

entries.speaker: Lala Escargot
entries.en: Investigating, huh?

entries.speaker: Lala Escargot
entries.en: Well, I'm sure you've got your reasons.

entries.speaker: Lala Escargot
entries.en: How about you kids drop in my store[n]where we can talk properly.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Oh, you wouldn't mind?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: That's most kind of you. We'll take you[n]up on that.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: W-Wait, you guys, I dunno...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Look, uh... she's not gonna ask too many[n]questions, right? Is she cool?
She knows all about Shinjuku.[clr 27]
Don't worry, she's cool.
Probably.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Then she'll be an invaluable source[n]of information, surely!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Yes. Precisely the person we were[n]looking for.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: If [fName]-kun trusts her, then[n]we have nothing to worry about.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Any friend of [fName]'s is a[n]friend of mine.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: "Probably"!?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: [fName] knows her, right? Then[n]I'm sure she's fine.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: We can at least see if she has any[n]answers for us.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Fine, all right... but she better not[n]blow our cover!
